Golden fixtures for the deterministic engine (Phase 1 of docs/agentic-renovator-design.md).

Generated by `backend/scripts/generate_golden_fixture.js`, which runs the
*actual* scheduling/cost/materials logic from `Renovation_Planner_v2.html`
under Node (no browser needed — none of that logic touches the DOM). The
Python engine in `src/renovator/engine` is tested against these exactly;
see `tests/conftest.py` and `tests/test_engine_golden.py`.

- `seed_plan_golden.json` — the app's built-in example plan, default settings
  (stage cascade on, no weekend work).
- `seed_plan_variant_golden.json` — same plan, with `work_weekends=true`,
  `sequence_stages=false`, and a fixed `start_override` on one task, to
  exercise the branches the defaults don't reach.

Regenerate after any change to the reference app's engine logic:

```bash
cd backend
node scripts/generate_golden_fixture.js --out tests/fixtures/seed_plan_golden.json
node scripts/generate_golden_fixture.js --out tests/fixtures/seed_plan_variant_golden.json \
  --work-weekends --no-sequence-stages --fixed-start mb_tv=2026-10-05
```

Never hand-edit these JSON files — if the numbers look wrong, the bug is
either in the reference app or in the generator, not in the fixture.
